topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture's focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate immune recognition, molecular patterns, and pattern recognition receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infection and tissue damage through conserved molecular patterns and specialized pattern recognition receptor systems.

topics.label: Inflammatory leukocyte recruitment, trafficking, and systemic consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the cellular and physiological responses triggered by innate activation, including sentinel cell signaling, leukocyte extravasation, lymphatic migration, and systemic inflammatory pathology.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammatory responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how inflammatory responses are turned off, how tissues undergo healing and remodeling, and what happens when inflammation becomes chronic.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic marks the conclusion of the lecture and previews the next topic.
